components.role: The PC algorithm serves as a constraint-based causal discovery method that provides high-recall edge skeletons.
Causal discovery is used to infer the underlying interaction network or structural graph from observational data.
Predictive modeling and forecasting are performed to evaluate which interactions genuinely improve the system dynamics or forecasting performance.

target_task.text: Simultaneous causal network inference and forecasting for dynamical systems.

limitation.text: Causal discovery methods reconstruct interaction networks without regard to whether the inferred structure supports prediction, and existing approaches combining both tasks rely on a single global hyperparameter that cannot recover the structure of heterogeneous systems.

combination.text: By combining constraint-based methods like PC with predictive modeling, a framework can simultaneously infer causal networks and forecast system dynamics by selecting the smallest set of neighbors that allows a predictive model to forecast each node near-optimally.

summary.text: By combining constraint-based methods like PC with predictive modeling, a framework can simultaneously infer causal networks and forecast system dynamics by selecting the smallest set of neighbors that allows a predictive model to forecast each node near-optimally [paper:2608.17452, paper:2608.27472]. The PC algorithm serves as a constraint-based causal discovery method that provides high-recall edge skeletons [paper:2608.27472]. Causal discovery is used to infer the underlying interaction network or structural graph from observational data [paper:2608.17452], and predictive modeling is performed to evaluate which interactions genuinely improve system dynamics or forecasting performance [paper:2608.17452].

target_user.text: Academic researchers and laboratories performing core flooding experiments and computer-aided simulations for porous medium characterization [patent:11913865].

jtbd.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Perform simultaneous causal network inference and forecasting for dynamical systems to accelerate total analysis time and visualize relative permeability and capillary pressure characteristics [paper:2608.17452, patent:11913865].

value_prop.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Simultaneously infer causal interaction networks and forecast system dynamics by identifying optimal local neighborhoods, thereby overcoming the limitations of global hyperparameters in heterogeneous systems [paper:2608.17452].

riskiest_assumption.text: The lowest viability score (V score: 1.0) on axis V implies that users will not adopt or pay for this simultaneous causal network inference and forecasting framework under real-world operational constraints [dvf:1].

mvp.text: Conduct customer interviews and a price acceptance test with academic researchers to evaluate willingness to pay for the simultaneous causal network inference and forecasting framework [dvf:1, patent:11913865].
mvp.type: customer interviews and price acceptance test

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of 40 percent positive willingness to pay in the price acceptance test and customer interviews [dvf:1].

kill_criteria.text: Fewer than a proposed threshold of 10 percent of interviewed customers express willingness to pay for the proposed solution during the MVP evaluation [dvf:1].

open_source.use: Provides time series causal discovery routines for inferring interaction networks from observational data [repo:bloomberg/causal-ts].
Supplies package-level tooling for causal time-series analysis to support graph inference [pkg:causalts].

to_build.text: A local state selector module that independently determines the smallest set of neighbors for each node to allow near-optimal predictive forecasting [paper:2608.17452].
